analysis.title: Foxconn Industrial Internet (601138.SS): AI server racks ramp up and strong cash flow to secure growth ahead; 3Q26 in line; Buy
key_insights: FII 3Q26 revenue was Rmb383,554m, +25% QoQ and +58% YoY, versus GS estimate Rmb376,321m (+2% actual vs GS) and Bloomberg consensus Rmb362,746m (+6% actual vs consensus).
3Q26 gross margin was 7.0%, unchanged from 2Q26. Operating income rose 23% QoQ to Rmb20,862m, 1% below GS and 3% above Bloomberg consensus, which GS calls largely in line.
3Q26 net income was Rmb16,634m, +27% QoQ and +60% YoY, 3% below GS and 1% above consensus.

GS expects 4Q26 gross profit to grow 25% QoQ, the same pace as 3Q26, driven by the ramp of new AI server racks with higher ASP, the CPO switch ramp, and smartphone metal precision parts entering peak season for a new model.
GS US Internet team forecasts leading US cloud providers will grow capex budgets by 84% / 52% / 13% YoY in 2026E-28E. Estimates were raised by 4% / 17% / 22% for 2026E-28E, to US$1,397bn by 2028E.
GS expects Hon Hai / FII to hold the leading ODM market position, with continued specification upgrades driving global market share gains.
Operating cash flow was Rmb3.2bn in 9M26, +178% YoY versus revenue +56% YoY in 9M26. GS attributes this to strong execution, short production cycle and bargaining power over suppliers.
GS says the entry barrier for AI server racks is rising because of US production requirements, tight supply and rising raw material costs, and expects more customers to rely on FII.

GS cut 2026E net income by 3% on lower gross margin and a higher opex ratio from increased R&D investment. Gross margin is expected to keep declining through 2028E as AI server racks take a larger revenue share. 2027E-28E estimates are largely unchanged.
GS net income is 15% above Bloomberg consensus in 2027E and 29% above in 2028E, reflecting its view of the AI infrastructure upcycle and FII's market position.

GS cut its target P/E multiple to 21.5x from 24.6x, citing industry de-rating from model transition, concerns about AI spending sustainability, and the Section 337 investigation on the AI supply chain. The 12M target price falls to Rmb106 from Rmb121. Buy maintained.
GS expects FII net income to grow at a 60% CAGR in 2025-28E versus 5% in 2021-24A, which it says supports a re-rating.
GS projects AI at 68% of FII gross profit in 2027E, with total gross profit of Rmb159bn.

market_movers.rationale: Target cut from Rmb121 on a lower target P/E of 21.5x (from 24.6x) applied to 2027E earnings. GS cites AI server rack ramp, cash flow and market share gains. Price Rmb45.00 implies 135.6% upside. 601138.SS is not US-listed.

sector_views.rationale: AI infrastructure capex growth and specification upgrades support FII's market share expansion, though the sector has de-rated on model transition, AI spending sustainability concerns and the Section 337 investigation.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported revenue Rmb383,554m vs GS est Rmb376,321m and Bloomberg consensus est Rmb362,746m: +25% QoQ, +58% YoY.
3Q26 reported operating income Rmb20,862m vs GS est Rmb21,017m and consensus est Rmb20,323m. Reported net income Rmb16,634m vs GS est Rmb17,205m and consensus est Rmb16,528m.
3Q26 reported gross margin 7.0% (GS est 7.2%, consensus est 7.4%), operating margin 5.4% (GS est 5.6%, consensus est 5.6%).
3Q26 reported diluted EPS Rmb0.84. GS estimates 4Q26E EPS Rmb1.03, 4Q26E revenue Rmb543,695m (+42% QoQ), gross profit Rmb33,470m (+25% QoQ) and net income Rmb20,403m.
GS estimates 2026E revenue Rmb1,485,109m (old Rmb1,475,803m), net income Rmb60,778m (old Rmb62,603m, -3%), EPS Rmb3.06 (old Rmb3.15).
GS estimates 2027E revenue Rmb3,619,524m, net income Rmb98,285m, EPS Rmb4.95. 2028E revenue Rmb5,877,414m, net income Rmb143,590m, EPS Rmb7.24.
Bloomberg consensus estimates 2027E net income Rmb85,408m and 2028E Rmb111,404m. GS is 15% and 29% higher. Consensus 2027E revenue is Rmb1,919,000m, and GS is 89% above it.
GS estimates gross margin of 6.7% in 2026E, 4.4% in 2027E and 4.0% in 2028E, versus Bloomberg consensus of 7.0% in 2027E and 2028E.
risk_factors: Worse-than-expected demand and profit from the AI server business.
Worse-than-expected iPhone component business expansion due to strong competition.
Slower-than-expected capacity ramp-up in new factories.
Lower-than-expected iPhone shipment, since FII supplies components for iPhone.
Market concerns on AI spending sustainability and model transition.
Rising raw material costs and tight supply.
charts_described: Exhibit 1 shows FII gross profit mix by product in 2027E, with gross profit at Rmb159bn and AI at 68% of the total.
Exhibit 7 shows FII 12M forward P/E with an average of 15.1x, +1 standard deviation at 19.2x and -1 standard deviation at 10.9x.
geopolitical: Section 337 investigation on the AI supply chain is cited as a factor behind industry de-rating.
US production requirements for AI server racks raise the entry barrier for suppliers.

tension_points.bull_case: AI server rack ramp with higher ASP, CPO switch ramp, rising US cloud capex (84% / 52% / 13% YoY in 2026E-28E) and spec upgrades drive a 60% net income CAGR in 2025-28E, with GS net income 15% / 29% above consensus in 2027E / 2028E.
tension_points.bear_case: Gross margin is expected to fall from 7.0% in 3Q26 to 4.4% in 2027E and 4.0% in 2028E as AI racks mix up, and the sector has de-rated on AI spending sustainability concerns and the Section 337 investigation.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Worse-than-expected demand and profit from the AI server business, as listed in GS's key downside risks.
